content: To evaluate the impact of the hierarchical memory, we implement a simplified version of CRAFT where the memory size of the context encoder is zero (CRAFT $-$ CE), thus effectively acting as if the pre-training component is a vanilla seq2seq model. In other words, this model cannot capture inter-comment dependencies, and instead at each step makes a prediction based only on the utterance encoding of the latest comment.
